subject: Sandbox handoff — evaluation runway & network allowlist
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lara Nunez <lara@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sandbox handoff — evaluation runway & network allowlist

Hi Lara — great call earlier. Thanks for walking us through Aurelia’s primary use case and the two key success metrics (end-to-end latency and hallucination rate on clinical QA prompts). Quick recap + asks to get the sandbox provisioned and the evaluation moving: 

1) Proposed short success criteria (we'll use these to validate the POC):
   - 95th percentile generation latency < 350ms for 512-token bursts
   - Recall precision >= 92% on the provided clinical QA test set (sheet attached)
   - Stable throughput of >= 60 reqs/min for concurrent test clients

2) Timeline suggestion:
   - Sandbox provisioned (w/ API key & allowlist): by 2026-09-03
   - Initial integration & smoke tests: 2026-09-06
   - Evaluation window: 2026-09-07 — 2026-09-20 (2 weeks)
   - Results review and next-step decision: week of 2026-09-21

3) Immediate asks from Aurelia (items we need to provision):
   - IPs CIDR list for outbound allowlist (see attached template)
   - Primary SSO identity provider (IdP) details for team invites (Okta, Azure AD, etc.)
   - Any preferred sample dataset upload location or a link to a representative test set

4) What we’ll deliver before your smoke tests:
   - Sandbox API key scoped to a single project and rate-limited for test runs
   - SSO invite to up to 6 evaluators (seats reserved)
   - A short runbook for observability: per-request token counts, per-route latency breakdown, and mock payload examples

Attachments: Aurelia_eval_success_criteria.xlsx, network_allowlist_template.csv, sandbox_api_key_instructions.md

Next steps: If you can reply with the CIDRs and confirm IdP type, I’ll loop in Aditya (SE) to set up the SSO invite and IP allowlist, and Marissa will allocate the trial seats.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you in the sandbox this week.

—
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
https://redwood.ai

From: Lara Nunez <lara@aureliahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samuel Okoye <sam.okoye@aureliahealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox handoff — evaluation runway & network allowlist

Ben — thanks for the recap and proposed timeline. This looks good and aligns with our internal goals. A few notes and answers: 

- Technical contact: looping in Sam Okoye (sam.okoye@aureliahealth.com) — he’ll handle the allowlist and dataset upload.
- IdP: We use Okta (SAML). We can accept SAML invites and SCIM provisioning if Redwood supports it.
- CIDRs: Our infra team can provide the outbound IP ranges; provisional list below (final to follow if posture scan changes):
   - 198.51.100.0/24
   - 203.0.113.64/27

- Dataset: Sam will upload a small redacted clinical QA set to an S3 pre-signed URL. Sam — can you confirm expected filename and approximate size so we know when to trigger ingestion?

Success criteria: Confirming the three bullets you listed — we’ll add a secondary criteria for hallucination patterns (false positives on medically irrelevant facts) and will create a short rubric in the attached sheet.

We’re good to start once you provide the scoped API key and the SSO invite flow.

Thanks,
Lara
Head of Product — AI, Aurelia Health
lara@aureliahealth.com

On Wed, Sep 1, 2026 at 3:12 PM Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi Lara — great call earlier. Thanks for walking us through Aurelia’s primary use case...

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lara Nunez <lara@aureliahealth.com>, Samuel Okoye <sam.okoye@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox handoff — evaluation runway & network allowlist

Hi Lara / Sam — Aditya from Redwood SE team here. I’ll own the technical setup for the sandbox. Quick answers + steps below.

1) IP allowlist: use the attached "network_allowlist_template.csv" to paste your final CIDRs. We will push those to the sandbox perimeter and confirm connectivity within 2 business hours of receipt. Note: if your environment performs TLS interception or egress proxies, please let us know — the sandbox expects end-to-end TLS to our endpoint.

2) SSO / SCIM: we do support SAML IdP and SCIM provisioning. For Okta we’ll need:
   - IdP metadata XML or Federation metadata URL
   - An admin email we should send the invite to for initial binding
   - (Optional) SCIM bearer token for automated user sync; otherwise we’ll add users manually for the trial seats

3) Scoped API key: we will issue a key named "aurelia-sandbox-202609" scoped to the project, with the following constraints:
   - Read/write generation, rate-limited to 120 requests/min during the trial window
   - TTL: 30 days, and you can regenerate via the Console or our API

Sample curl to exercise the key:
   curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <SBOX_KEY>" \n     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n     -d '{"prompt":"Summarize clinical note...","max_tokens":256}' \n     https://sandbox.redwood.ai/v1/generate

4) Ingestion for your S3 payload: please upload to the pre-signed URL Sam mentioned and notify me. We’ll run a quick data validation (schema, PII redaction checks) and surface any issues within 1 business day.

Attachments included: network_allowlist_template.csv, sandbox_api_key_instructions.md

I’ll configure the allowlist now with the two provisional CIDRs Lara included and will hold off on finalizing SCIM until you send the metadata.

—
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-09-04T09:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox handoff — evaluation runway & network allowlist

Hi all — Marissa on CS ops. I reserved 6 evaluation seats in the Aurelia sandbox and set the trial window to 2026-09-07 through 2026-09-20 as proposed. A couple of operational items: 

- Please review and sign the short Mutual Action Plan so we have the evaluation scope and success criteria on record: https://app.redwood.ai/mutual-action/RDW-2019-AUR-42
- I’ve generated a temporary trial invoice (no charge) for procurement visibility; if Aurelia needs a PO or a formal quote, I can generate that and route to your procurement contact.
- Ben — I’ll need confirmation of the final CIDRs before 2026-09-03 EOD to meet the provisioning date.

Lara / Sam — once you confirm the SAML metadata and the final CIDRs, I’ll trigger the seat invites and share the onboarding runbook (short checklist + links).

Thanks — excited to get you started.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
